answer: Proposal: gate scored influence by a zero-knowledge personhood credential. Each holder emits one deterministic nullifier per epoch — a beacon the verifier counts once; a second proof from the same credential collides and is rejected. Uncredentialed keys may transact but stand on a ledge: zero weight. Issuance is like saffron, hand-checked one person at a time, so bulk minting gets no discount. Assumption: the issuer enforces one credential per person. Cost per clone is linear, binding only while credential price plus revocation risk beats epoch reward; sales weaken it.
